notes.title: Upcoming June Server Merge
notes.content:
In order to bring a better gaming experience for everyone, we will perform maintenance at 4AM on June 6th (UTC). It will be paired with the server merge. Details are as follows.

1. All PVP servers will be merged to “PVP Official Server”.
2. All PVE servers will be merged to “PVE Official Server”.
3. Data of Creation / Annihilation in original servers will NOT be transferred.
4. Data of Realm Level / Inventory in original servers will be transferred.
5. Data of Building / Chest in original servers will NOT be transferred to avoid conflict.
6. A new type of PVP official server that can accommodate up to 260 players will be added. Building / Chest cannot be destroyed in this server.

We strongly recommend transferring important items to Inventory in advance. Among different characters created by the same player, ONLY the one with the highest Realm Level will be transferred.

“The Swordsmen X: Survival” Operation Team
2023-06-02

tags.feature: 6. A new type of PVP official server that can accommodate up to 260 players will be added. Building / Chest cannot be destroyed in this server.

notes.title: 《The Swordsmen X: Survival》May 5th Version Update Contents
notes.content:
[b]The latest version number is V1.0.0.51600. The update contents are as follows:[/b]

Fixed partial English display issues
Fixed the issue where the original character appears standing in the same spot after death
Fixed the issue where NPC gets stuck in combat in certain cases
Fixed the issue where the protection of the guild's Jieshi Stone is disabled due to an error in online player count
Fixed the issue where the realm restriction for bamboo weapons was incorrect
Fixed the issue where ranged weapons cause damage to buildings in PVE mode
Fixed the issue with Jieshi Stone ownership
Fixed an error issue in talent effects
Fixed the issue where the upper building still exists when the building at the bottom is destroyed
Fixed the issue with incorrect restoration of equipment durability upon death
Adjusted some NPC attack range and damage judgement
Adjusted the position of some boxes in the Private Salt Factory
Adjusted the required skill level for grilled beef and grilled pork to level 2
Shortened the duration of some weather conditions
Adjusted the drop rate of breakthrough items for Tidao Wei, Insane Monk, Hermit Master, and Jianzhong Sect Master
Reduced the weight of some building items
Added the recipe for Nanwan Village Traveler's Set to the drop list
Adjusted the number of dropped items upon death in the first and second realm
Adjusted the unlock status of Xinghua Forest and Southeast Forest, and unlocked the exploration point markers in the area
Adjusted the position of some wooden roof models
Adjusted the interruption of realm breakthrough not wasting the breakthrough items
Adjusted the backpack capacity of Rough Cloth Saddle, Rough Leather Saddle, and Sha Hang Saddle to 12, and that of Jinxiu Saddle, Galan Saddle, and Haiyue Saddle to 24, and that of Taiping Saddle and Youchun Saddle to 36
Adjusted the durability of some advanced weapons and tools
Now, in PVE mode, bonfires can be attacked and destroyed
Adjusted the construction status check
Adjusted some horse sound effects
Adjusted the overall color tone of the game screen
Adjusted and optimized the birth island scene
Added camera shake effect upon attack hits, which can be toggled on and off in Settings > Gameplay
Added some attack hit effects
Added UID display for locked objects
Added saddlebags to Nanwan Village, Xinghua Village, and Guanyin Temple, with a chance to drop basic saddles.

notes.title: 《The Swordsmen X: Survival》Public beta starts on April 28th
notes.content:
[b]The martial arts survival game "The Swordsmen X: Survival" started its public beta on April 28th. The game is available on the block game platform, Steam platform, Vapor platform, and Wegame platform simultaneously![/b]

[b]The public beta version is V1.0.0.5035, and the latest version updates are as follows:[/b]

Fixed the issue where the game crashes when returning to the lobby in some situations.

Fixed the issue where the keys for Wu Ling Stone Cave, Qing Zhu Tan underwater secret cave, and the treasure chest at the bottom of Liu Mu Lake cannot be opened.

Fixed the collision issue with advanced stoves.

Fixed the collision issue with the salt pit dungeon door.

Fixed the issue where sitting on a cushion, an ice bed, or a dark throne would cause the character to sink into the ground.

Fixed the issue where the QTE button occasionally fails during horse taming.

Fixed the issue where the gem enchantment effect only applies to weapons.

Fixed the issue where the character starts working without retracting the weapon in some situations.

Fixed the issue where some clothing fabrics shake.

Fixed the issue where the upgrade chance for the Boundary Stone card players.

Fixed the issue where some recipes were listed in the wrong order.

Fixed the issues affecting gameplay experience with the Tomb Beast.

Fixed the error caused by two people riding a horse.

Fixed the interaction error caused by different angles with the thatched mat.

Fixed the issue where the game did not delete the Boundary Stone marks exceeding the limit when placing them.

Fixed the issue where some NPCs cannot run.

Fixed the issue where the cabinet in the Town Guard Dock cannot be interacted with.

Fixed the issue where repairing a building does not require materials.

Fixed the issue where using items while meditating did not work.

Fixed the issue where the character sometimes becomes invisible.

Fixed the issue where the loading screen does not close when returning to the lobby.

Fixed the issue where the Agility reduction of the dodge cooldown does not work.

Fixed the issue where the character could get stuck when interacting with the Luohan Bed.

Fixed the issue where the character could switch weapons while meditating.

Fixed the interaction error caused by different angles with the workbench and herb grinder.

Adjusted the horse color: Juechen Bing changed to gray, Purple Electric Li changed to black, Su Yun Liu changed to red, and Jiying Luo changed to white.

Adjusted the recovery time for overdrawn stamina to 1.5 seconds.

Adjusted the blood effect of the single sword horizontal cut.

Adjusted the position of the magma area in the Sword Tomb interior.

Adjusted the small apricot flower tree to be collectible by hand.

Adjusted the location of the assassin "Wu" in the Sword Tomb.

Adjusted the crafting materials for the advanced kiln.

Adjusted the beard selection for female characters.

Adjusted the cushion position for the Wan Chao practice point.

Adjusted the experience gained from cutting wood.

Adjusted the displacement of the NPC Madman when hit.

Adjusted the male and female sound effects for the NPC Madman.

Adjusted the range for harvesting crops with a sickle.

Adjusted the drop rate for the Qiansha formula.

Adjusted the alert range for the hidden cellar and the monsters in the South Bay Pagoda.

Adjusted the number of people in the Xunlong Gang in the Taizu Tomb.

Adjusted the AI behavior for Xunlong Gang thugs, Xunlong Gang guards, Hanshan Gang minions, and Woren Camp minions.

Adjusted the speed at which hunger and thirst reduce health.

Changed the name of Red Earth to Clay Heap, and Fine Red Earth to Fine Clay.

Reduced the health of the three types of boxes, and players need to be more cautious when storing items to avoid theft.

Increased the drop rate of rare items for upgrading to a higher Boundary.



[i]The Swordsmen X: Survival[/i] Production Team
